At crates/tmux/src/control.rs:732-754, lock open uses O_NOFOLLOW, create(true), and truncate(false). Metadata from the opened descriptor must identify a regular file, our UID and exactly one link before descriptor chmod at line 752 or flock at line 754. The platform flag comes from nix::libc::O_NOFOLLOW through crates/core/src/program.rs:182. A planted final-component symlink can no longer redirect permission narrowing or create its dangling target; a hard-linked or foreign-owned opened object is rejected before these side effects.

The parent guard at control.rs:374-403 uses symlink_metadata before socket-side creation. It requires a real directory owned by our UID, or root with sticky set; group/other write requires sticky. Rejected parents select the state-root lock. The production AttachLock::take fallback regression at control.rs:1379-1398 verifies that the rejected shared parent receives no socket-side lock creation.
